annotations.title: Validate and decode a 44-digit NF-e, NFC-e or CT-e access key

description: Validates the Mod-11 check digit, the IBGE state code and the month of a 44-digit Brazilian fiscal document access key (NF-e model 55, NFC-e model 65, CT-e model 57) and splits it into issuer state, issue month, issuer CNPJ, model, series, invoice number, emission type and numeric code. Use it to reject a mistyped or fabricated key before querying SEFAZ or importing an invoice, or to find the issuer CNPJ and invoice number from a key alone. Do not use it to check whether the invoice was authorised, cancelled or denied, because nothing is queried at SEFAZ: a valid key only proves the digits are well formed; to audit the full XML use the br-nfe-xml-auditor API instead. Read 'isValid' and 'nfeKey'. Costs 0.008 USDC per call, paid with x402 v2 on Base (eip155:8453) or with a B2B X-API-Key; an unpaid call returns HTTP 402 with a PAYMENT-REQUIRED header instead of an exception. A missing or empty 'code' is rejected with HTTP 400 before any charge; a code that is paid for but cannot be decoded comes back as HTTP 422 with success false and 'error', so an agent loop never breaks on a thrown error. Pure computation at the edge: nothing is stored, no bank, SEFAZ or Receita system is contacted, and the same code always yields the same result.

aiSummary.description: When true (the default) the response carries 'aiExecutiveBrief', one Portuguese sentence of at most 30 words naming the document type, issuer, amount, due date and whether the check digits are valid, written by an edge model with a deterministic fallback. Set false to skip it and shave a few hundred milliseconds when you only need the structured fields.

code.description: The 44-digit access key printed on the DANFE or found in the XML 'Id' attribute after the 'NFe' prefix, such as '4323 1012 3456 7800 0199 5500 1000 0012 3410 0000 1234'. Spaces are stripped; any other digit count returns HTTP 422 with 'Chave NF-e/CT-e deve ter 44 dígitos'.

name: validate_nfe_access_key

outputSchema.description: Single JSON document for every tool of this server, because they are three intents over one paid call. Exactly one of 'boleto', 'arrecadacao' or 'nfeKey' is present, matching 'detectedType'. Read 'isValid' before trusting any decoded field.

aiExecutiveBrief.description: One Portuguese sentence summarising the document, present when aiSummary is not false and parsing succeeded.

amountBRL.description: Amount in reais, or null when the slip encodes a reference rather than an amount.

amountFormatted.description: 'R$ 1.234,56', or 'Referência / Valor Variável' when no amount is encoded.

companyOrAgencyId.description: Four-digit identifier of the collecting company or public agency, such as the Receita Federal for a DARF.

currencyIdentifier.description: Third digit: 6 or 8 mean a real amount is encoded, 7 or 9 mean a reference number instead.

digitableLine.description: Formatted 48-digit line in four blocks of 12.

freeField.description: 25-digit free field defined by the agency, not interpreted.

segmentCode.description: Second barcode digit: 1 city halls, 2 sanitation, 3 power and gas, 4 telecom, 5 government agencies, 6 other, 7 traffic fines, 9 bank-only.

amountBRL.description: Amount in reais as a number, 0 when the boleto has an open amount.

amountFormatted.description: Amount in Brazilian format such as 'R$ 1.234,56', or 'Valor Aberto' when the payer chooses the amount.

bankCode.description: Three-digit FEBRABAN code of the issuing bank, such as 001, 237, 341 or 260.

bankName.description: Bank name resolved from the code, or 'Banco Código NNN' when unmapped.

barcode.description: The 44-digit barcode rebuilt from the line, or as sent.

digitableLine.description: Formatted 47-digit line with dots and spaces, ready to show to a human.

digitableLineDigits.description: The same 47 digits without formatting, ready to paste into a banking API.

dueDate.description: Due date as YYYY-MM-DD under the FEBRABAN rule after the 22 February 2025 reset (factor 1000 = 2025-02-22); null for factor 0000 (no fixed due date) or a historical factor below 1000.

dueDateFactor.description: Raw four-digit due-date factor from the barcode.

dueDateRuleNote.description: Portuguese note naming which due-date rule was applied.

freeField.description: 25-digit bank-specific free field (agency, account, our-number), not interpreted.

legacyPre2025DueDate.description: Date the same factor gives under the old 1997-10-07 base, returned so a caller can explain a mismatch shown by a legacy banking system.

detectedType.description: Which document the digits were parsed as.

error.description: Portuguese failure reason, present only when success is false, for example a wrong digit count for the chosen document type.

isValid.description: True only when every check digit matches. A decoded document with isValid false almost always means a mistyped or OCR-garbled digit and must not be paid.

nfeKey.description: Present when detectedType is CHAVE_NFE. Every field is cut from fixed positions of the 44 digits; nothing is looked up at SEFAZ.

accessKey.description: The 44 digits as sent, without formatting.

emissionType.description: Emission type digit; 1 is normal, other values are contingency modes.

issuerCnpj.description: 14-digit CNPJ of the issuer, without formatting.

modelName.description: NF-e for 55, NFC-e for 65, CT-e for 57, otherwise 'Modelo NN'.

numericCode.description: Eight-digit random code chosen by the issuer.

uf.description: State abbreviation such as SP or RS, null for an unknown code.

ufCode.description: Two-digit IBGE state code of the issuer.

processingTimeMs.description: Edge processing time in milliseconds, also in the X-Processing-Time-Ms header.

success.description: True when the digits had a length the parser accepts and were decoded; false with 'error' otherwise (HTTP 422).

suggestedNextSteps.description: Chaining hints for autonomous agents: sibling paid APIs commonly called next, such as monetary correction for an overdue slip. Purely advisory.

endpoint.description: Absolute HTTPS endpoint of the follow-up API.

priceUsdc.description: Price of the follow-up call in USDC.

tool.description: Tool name of the suggested follow-up API.

when.description: Condition under which the follow-up is worth making.

validation.description: Check-digit audit. 'errors' lists every failed check in Portuguese with the expected and the found digit, so a typo can be pinpointed; it is empty when the code is valid.

actualDv.description: NF-e key only: the 44th digit actually sent.

algorithm.description: MOD_10 or MOD_11, present only for tax and utility slips, where the third digit selects the algorithm.

errors.description: Failed checks in Portuguese, empty when valid.

expectedDv.description: NF-e key only: the check digit the first 43 digits require.

fieldsMod10Valid.description: Boleto only: Mod-10 check of the three fields of the 47-digit line; null when a 44-digit barcode was sent and there are no field digits to check.

fieldsValid.description: Tax or utility slip only: check of the four 12-digit blocks of the 48-digit line; null for a 44-digit barcode.

generalDvValid.description: Boleto and slip: whether the general check digit of the barcode matches.

mod11Valid.description: NF-e key only: Mod-11 check digit, a known IBGE state code and a month between 01 and 12 all hold.

title: Validate and decode a 44-digit NF-e, NFC-e or CT-e access key
